ownership: Path owns initialized parallel Vec<Point>/Vec<u8> in the safe core; fields are private and all public mutations preserve matching lengths.
Store validates monotonic non-reused integer IDs. C++ PathData owns only a checked ID through PathOwner; it no longer owns persistent malloc/realloc buffers in experimental builds.
Deep copy, self assignment, empty-source assignment no-op, clear, hashing, wrapping append and alignment execute in Rust.
Native reads receive detached snapshots; transforms and polygons explicitly replace from detached packets. No Rust path address, point slice, or mutable loan crosses the native adapter ABI.
boundary: A dedicated atomic admission serializes all path registry access. HRTB closures cannot return state references; the unsafe Sync implementation is justified by exclusive admission and the Store owning only Send values.

GDI obtains synchronous output pointers only to initialized exact-count local vectors. Only complete successful GetPath output becomes path data. Renderer operation guards bound borrowed HDC lifetime and selection state.

Text path control uses the safe core with narrow Windows calls: spacing/legacy branch, UTF16 consumption, ignored partial failures, wrapping offsets, checked failure restoration and Release successful-call non-restoration.
Native adapter serialization covers FFI calls; full host concurrency, reentry and arbitrary external callbacks are not established by this boundary.
preserved_quirks: Assigning an empty source leaves a nonempty destination intact.
Spaced text stops at first NUL; unspaced text uses full CString length including its NUL tail. Empty spaced input leaves the existing path untouched.
Partial begin/text/end Boolean failures are ignored by CText; unspaced checked failures restore the prior font. Successful Release calls leave the font selected.
Begin clears before invoking GDI, even when BeginPath fails. CloseFigure failure is ignored in Release. EndPath failure aborts the GDI path.
Append and alignment retain directly observed machine-integer wraparound at i32 bounds.
remaining_native_work: CWord::Transform floating transforms and CPolygon::PrepareDraw scalar geometry.
ScanLineData curve/line evaluation and scan-conversion control; its readers now share one detached path snapshot per ScanConvert.
Word/line/subtitle and cache object graphs; all player/CSRI/AviSynth/VirtualDub/DirectShow/XySubFilter consumer adapters and vendors.
Resolve negative/short GetPath and allocator outcomes without reading or reproducing native uninitialized memory; broaden FP, Debug and host concurrency evidence.
